item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: A journey through states of water
item.stem:
Yusuf compares how fast equal amounts of water dry. He can use a shallow wide plate or a narrow-necked bottle, and he can change temperature and how humid the air is.

Which claims about evaporation are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: With the same amount, temperature, and humidity, water in the shallow wide plate evaporates faster than water in the narrow-necked bottle.
options.B: The wide plate always finishes first, even if it holds much more water than the bottle.
options.C: With temperature and exposed area equal, water evaporates faster in dry air than in humid air.
options.D: Water near room temperature cannot evaporate at all until it boils.
